doc: Act II's battle sounds new in Act II (M4-A2P-093): skills that would otherwise be silent. Files from assets_src/sfx/act2_skill_sfx.py (plain git, ADR 0175). Same row format as sfx_battle.json.

skill_fin_cut._note: M4-A2P-093: the Wakefin's fin_cut (wakefin.md §4, the sheet's proposed id): the seam's high hiss along the rail, then the sweep (contact 0.8 s)

skill_sound_dive._note: M4-A2P-093: the Wakefin's sound_dive (wakefin.md §4, the sheet's proposed id): the blade sinking: a falling plunk, bubbles going down, a thrum still there below (it's gone deep, not gone; ADR 0204 §3)

skill_wakefin_rise._note: M4-A2P-093: the Wakefin's wakefin_rise (wakefin.md §4, the sheet's proposed id): the sea-glow ring opening at 1.9 kHz, then the breach under one hero (contact 0.85 s)

skill_wake_wash._note: M4-A2P-093: the Wakefin's wake_wash (wakefin.md §4, the sheet's proposed id): the hard turn, the tail slap (0.75 s), the wake washing over the deck

skill_bill_strike._note: M4-A2P-093: the Wakefin's bill_strike (wakefin.md §4, the sheet's proposed id): phase 2: it rears at the bow, the stab and the knock on the planking (0.7 s)

phase_close_circle._note: M4-A2P-093: the Wakefin's close_circle phase (ADR 0204 §6): it rams the hull, the barge rocks and creaks

abl_core_pulse._note: M4-A2P-093: the Lamp Engine's bared core pulsing (all foes): a hum swelling into a bright glass bloom (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_drowner_drag._note: M4-A2P-093: two roots haul a hero along the water: creak, drag, the roots knocking shut (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_glide_lash._note: M4-A2P-093: the gallery ray's tail: the broad wing, a whip of air, the lash (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_horn_toss._note: M4-A2P-093: the ram's head-toss: a hoof, the wet locks swinging, the heavy blow, water shed (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_lamp_flare._note: M4-A2P-093: the lamps loosed together (darkness): salt-glass rings rising to a flash, then dimming (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_lamp_gather._note: M4-A2P-093: every lamp swings to face the party: ratchets, a rising hum, the lamps chiming in turn (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_lamp_trim._note: M4-A2P-093: the shear arm snips: the blade, the brass ring of the arm (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_leech_bite._note: M4-A2P-093: the fen leech's draining bite: a wet catch and the pull drawn back up to it (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_ram_bellow._note: M4-A2P-093: the bellow and the snow sliding off the terrace (slow) (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_ram_charge._note: M4-A2P-093: the stamp, three strides gathering, the drive through (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_ram_charge_gather._note: M4-A2P-093: the head drops and it paws the terrace: two slow hooves, a snort, a held breath (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_rime_spine._note: M4-A2P-093: a salt-glass spine breaking in a striker (slow): the crack, the shards, the ring (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_rising_water._note: M4-A2P-093: the Drowner's roots spread and the tannin water rises over the party (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_root_drag._note: M4-A2P-093: the root crab drags its target into the roots (delay): a smaller creak and drag, a knock (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_root_stamp._note: M4-A2P-093: the risen Drowner stamps on its root-feet: a heavy wet blow, the roots knocking (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_scree_slide._note: M4-A2P-093: the scree crawler sheds split scree: grit and stones sliding, snow hiss behind (no ice) (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_skate_sting._note: M4-A2P-093: the glass skate's tail from the sand (poison): sand, the whip, the sting's sharp tick (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_tannin_jet._note: M4-A2P-093: the archer's jet, which knocks its target back: the pressured hiss, the splash, the shove (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)

abl_tide_gather._note: M4-A2P-093: the risen Drowner draws its roots in (a charge): slow creaks, the water drawn off, a low moan (assets_src/sfx/act2_ability_sfx.py)
